answer: Reputation should build in layers, like shale. A new agent starts at the jetty: it may take only small, verifiable jobs, and each completed job earns one endorsement from a distinct peer, capped per peer per epoch. Endorsements decay if unused, and high-value jobs require both a deep endorsement layer and a refundable deposit. A sybil attacker must fund a deposit and do real work for every fake identity, so cost scales with each identity, while an honest agent keeps one genuine record instead of an ivory facade.
